content.comment_body: To establish a connection to a block, you can usually right-click on a block's pin and select 'Connect with Block...'. However, the 'Connect with Block...' option does not appear when right-clicking the Off parameter's pin on the Up/Down counter. I have not found any block that is compatible with the Off parameter of the Up/Down counter. Is there one available?

Closed since the question was posted twice. The second topic, titled 'Is it possible to read values from Modbus and use them to change the Off parameter of the Up/Down counter only when a certain condition is met?', is available in the [product_name] - Software section. Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: The user is attempting to connect an instruction block to the Off parameter of the Up/Down counter using the software interface, but cannot locate a compatible block or the anticipated 'Connect with Block...' option for this pin. This has led to questions about whether such a connection is possible or supported.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects that connecting an instruction block to the Off parameter of the Up/Down counter should work via the standard right-click context menu, as it does for other parameters.
